My bot now reads the allotment garden rules and answers questions about them. It looks at each
word of the question that is longer than three letters and returns the first rule line that
contains it.

Questions it gets wrong:

The question "Where do plot clippings go?" gets the rule about keeping paths clear, because
"plot" is the first long word that matches and that rule comes first. The real answer is the green
bins rule. The bot stops at the first word that matches instead of finding the best line.

Also some other questions about bins did not work that well sometimes.

I would like to improve the matching next week.
